column1: # Columns (whitespace separated): src  dest  mode  required
#   mode      must be "ro"; writable paths come only from the command line (--write)
#   required  yes = abort if src is missing; no = skip with a warning
# Every src must be a real mount point or lie inside one, and nothing may be
# mounted below it: a read-only bind protects exactly one filesystem. Never list an
# autofs map root such as /dcs04; list the exports under it (/dcs04/lieber).
# The wrapper checks this against /proc/mounts at every launch.
# --- host system: makes the sandbox look like the node it runs on ------------
/var/lib/sss            /var/lib/sss            ro  yes   # SSSD sockets: user and group names
# /dcs06/lieber and /dcs10/lieber do not exist on current nodes
